violated_contract: A periodic relay or transcript barrier must not force a storage window to commit at the polling cadence. Custody acknowledgements must follow immutable window receipts while live delivery continues independently; otherwise a one-second relay multiplies object writes and privacy-authority reads that belong at the sixty-second pack boundary.
canonical_prevention: Separate the gate for scheduled commits from explicit window flush boundaries. Retain original audio through the active window and defer client coverage publication behind an accepted-frame checkpoint. Test many relay cycles against actual storage call counts, plus crash, disconnect, failed earlier commits and continuous transcript arrival.
